scope: Proposition 4.6 (Tail asymptotics) of the manuscript “Global Spherical Shells on Minimal Surfaces of Class VII” (preprints/Global-Spherical-Shells-on-Minimal-Surfaces-of-Class-VII-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 060 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d441e45f773bce9f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let E satisfy (4.3). A finite-growth holomorphic section of KY ⊗ E or KY ⊗ E−1 on a positive tail vanishes on a shorter positive tail. A finite-growth holomorphic section of E has, in the prescribed trivialization at either end on which it is defined, the expansion s = c± + O(e−δ|h| ) for some δ > 0, with the same conclusion for every derivative of the error. On the positive end c+ = 0 implies s = 0. Consequently the positive-end coefficient is injective on global weighted holomorphic sections of E.
